globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClip
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
def studentizerClip (B d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (-(min B (1 / 2 : ℝ))) (min d B)
globalDeclarations.justification: S12 literal max(-(min B (1/2)), min d B); no hidden indicator; unrestricted real B,d definition.

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClipBudget
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
def studentizerClipBudget (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) : ℝ :=
  C0 * (((1 + rho) * y) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) +
    residualEnergyJ n r x / ((1 + rho) * y * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)))
globalDeclarations.justification: S10 literal budget with sigma0=1+rho and exact196 J; total real division at n=0 or y=0.

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.clippedCenteredDelta
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
def clippedCenteredDelta (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → Ω) : ℝ :=
  if projectionV n g x = 0 then 0 else
    studentizerClip (studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho y x)
      (centeredDelta n g r x)
globalDeclarations.justification: Explicit V=0 zero guard; nonzero branch uses exact196 guarded d and literal B; no new good-event switch.

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.clippedCenteredStatistic
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
def clippedCenteredStatistic (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → Ω) : ℝ :=
  if projectionV n g x = 0 then 0 else
    (projectionW n g x + residualStatisticD n r x) /
      (projectionV n g x *
        Real.sqrt (1 + clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x))
globalDeclarations.justification: Same V=0 guard, numerator exact W+D, denominator V*sqrt(1+clipped d).

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClip_contract
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
theorem studentizerClip_contract (B d : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + studentizerClip B d ∧
    |studentizerClip B d| ≤ B ∧
    |studentizerClip B d| ≤ |d| ∧
    (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ d → |d| ≤ B → studentizerClip B d = d)
globalDeclarations.justification: B>=0 gives 0<=min(B,1/2)<=B,1/2. Outer max bounds imply floor and absolute B bound. Split d>=0/d<0 to obtain |clip|<=|d|. Under d>=-1/2 and |d|<=B, split B<=1/2 to show lower endpoint<=d, so both min/max fix d. Includes all equality boundaries.

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.clippedCenteredDelta_bounds
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
theorem clippedCenteredDelta_bounds (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → Ω) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :

      studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho y x ∧
    |clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x| ≤ |centeredDelta n g r x| ∧
    (0 < projectionV n g x →
      0 < projectionV n g x *
        Real.sqrt (1 + clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x))

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.centered_studentizer_factorization
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
theorem centered_studentizer_factorization (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hV : 0 < projectionV n g x)
    (hLower : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ centeredDelta n g r x) :
    0 < Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x) ∧
    Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x) =
      projectionV n g x * Real.sqrt (1 + centeredDelta n g r x)
globalDeclarations.justification: V>0 gives V^2!=0. Unfold exact196 guarded d to d=S/V^2-1; div_eq_iff and ring derive S=V^2*(1+d). d>=-1/2 gives radicand>0. sqrt_mul with V^2>=0 and sqrt_sq with V>=0 yield factorization and positivity. No hsym required for this definitional algebra; original centered-square interpretation retains existing hsym,n>=4.

globalDeclarations.name: Shao.OQ5.P51.clippedCentered_comparison_on_projectionGood
globalDeclarations.exactFrozenHeadOrDefinition:
theorem clippedCentered_comparison_on_projectionGood (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → Ω) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hy : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y)
    (hGood : x ∈ projectionGood n g y)
    (hDom : |centeredDelta n g r x| ≤ studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho y x)
    (hLower : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ centeredDelta n g r x) :
    clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x = centeredDelta n g r x ∧
    0 < projectionV n g x *
      Real.sqrt (1 + clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x) ∧
    0 < Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x) ∧
    projectionV n g x * Real.sqrt (1 + clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x) =
      Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x) ∧
    clippedCenteredStatistic n g r C0 rho y x =
      (if Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x) = 0 then 0 else
        (projectionW n g x + residualStatisticD n r x) /
          Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x))
globalDeclarations.justification: Exact196 projectionGood_bounds under n>=4,y>=1 gives V>0. Displayed hDom implies B>=|d|>=0; hLower and scalar fix imply clipped d=d. Previous factorization proves both denominators positive/equal; both quotient guards reduce with proved nonzero facts. No C0/rho sign condition or originalT global interface covertly assumed.

    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ)
